listening.en: The portable scanner was a game changer for our archive team: we could record fragile pages where they were stored instead of moving them to another building, although checking the captions still took time.
listening.zh: 便攜掃描器大幅改變檔案團隊局面：可在存放處記錄脆弱書頁，不用搬到另一棟樓；核圖說仍需時間。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼具體改變支持 game changer？

options.en: Fragile pages could be scanned in place rather than transported to another building.
options.zh: 脆弱書頁可原地掃描，不用運到另一棟樓。

options.en: The scanner supplied captions that had already been checked for accuracy.
options.zh: 掃描器提供已核準確的圖說。

options.en: Only the colour of the archive labels changed.
options.zh: 只有檔案標籤顏色改了。

options.en: The team stopped recording the fragile pages altogether.
options.zh: 團隊完全停止記錄脆弱書頁。

listening.explanationZh: 重大改變在書頁可原地記錄，不是掃描器已提供經核實圖說，仍需花時間核文字。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼掃描器對檔案團隊那麼重要？
reply.promptEn: Why was the scanner so important for the archive team?

options.en: It let us record fragile pages without moving them to another building.
options.zh: 它讓我們不用搬到另一棟樓便記錄脆弱書頁。

options.en: It was a game changer because scanning could happen where the pages were stored.
options.zh: 它是改變局面的關鍵，因可在書頁存放處掃描。

options.en: The team gained a practical option that the old fixed setup did not provide.
options.zh: 團隊有了舊固定設備不能提供的實際選項。

options.en: We could change the handling process substantially instead of transporting the originals.
options.zh: 我們可大幅改處理程序，不用運送原本。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答實際新增能力，不把核圖說說成自動。

scene.promptZh: 即時字幕讓原本聽不清台詞的組員首次可參與討論，但字幕仍需修錯。哪句準確？

options.en: The captions were a game changer for participation, though the text still needed checking.
options.zh: 字幕對參與大幅改變局面，文字仍需核。

options.en: The captions only changed the visual decoration without affecting participation.
options.zh: 字幕只改外觀裝飾，不影響參與。

options.en: The new captions have already passed a full wording review.
options.zh: 新字幕已通過完整措辭檢視。

scene.explanationZh: 字幕讓原本不能聽清者首次參與，是重大作用；錯字仍需修，不是只裝飾或文字已全核。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 a game changer？

options.en: A new tool enables an important activity that was previously impractical.
options.zh: 新工具讓原本不可行的重要活動成為可能。

options.en: A cosmetic detail changes while the practical possibilities remain the same.
options.zh: 外觀細節改了，實際可能性卻不變。

options.en: A change substantially alters the way a group can work.
options.zh: 改動大幅改變小組可怎樣工作。

contrast.explanationZh: 只外觀小改不自動支持大幅改局面。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴因掃描器有幫助，就想省全部圖說核對；掃描只處理影像。哪句最好？

options.en: It changes how we capture pages, but caption accuracy still needs a separate check.
options.zh: 它改變怎擷取書頁，但圖說準確仍需另核。

options.en: The caption audit is already complete, so we can describe the wording as verified.
options.zh: 圖說審核已完，所以可把文字說成核實。

options.en: If captions still need work, the scanner has not changed what the team can do.
options.zh: 若圖說仍需做，掃描器就沒改變團隊可做甚麼。

dialogue.explanationZh: 掃描改影像擷取，但圖說審核仍待做；不能報已完，也不能因仍有文字工作而否定新增能力。

speaking.en: It was a game changer for what the group could do, even though it did not remove every remaining task.
speaking.zh: 它大幅改變小組可做的事，雖然沒除去每項剩餘工作。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出實際改變。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你向住在遠方的家人介紹祖母首次能用放大顯示讀自己舊信，她過去只能請別人代讀。你想描述這對她自主閱讀的重大改變，也交代模糊筆跡仍需家人協助，不泛稱能處理所有信件。用一至兩句英文更新近況。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用從代讀到自己讀很多信的前後差支持重大改變，保留模糊筆跡協助，不把自主變任何情況完全不用幫。

examples.en: The enlarged display has been a game changer for Grandma’s independent reading: she can now read many of her old letters herself. We still help with the faint handwriting.
examples.zh: 放大顯示大幅改變外婆自主閱讀：她現在可自己讀很多舊信；淡筆跡仍由我們幫忙。

examples.en: For Grandma, the magnified pages are a game changer because she no longer has to rely on us for every line. Some unclear words still need a second pair of eyes.
examples.zh: 對外婆，放大書頁是改變局面的關鍵，因她不再每行都需依賴我們；不清字仍需別人幫看。

takeaways.en: The new access route was a game changer for visitors who could not use the steps.
takeaways.zh: 新通路對不能用梯級的訪客大幅改變局面。

takeaways.en: A simple shared record became a game changer when the team no longer had to reconstruct every handover from memory.
takeaways.zh: 團隊不再需憑記憶重組每次交接時，簡單共用紀錄成了改變局面的關鍵。

titleZh: 表現超出規模所帶來的預期

brief.meaningEn: Have an impact or performance greater than one’s size or resources would suggest.
brief.meaningZh: 發揮超出規模或資源所令人預期的影響或表現。
brief.grammar: a small team punches above its weight; people punch above their weight; possessive agrees with the subject.
brief.register: Established boxing metaphor. The comparison is relative to size or resources, not a claim of being best overall.
brief.boundaryZh: 需有規模資源與表現比較；不表示沒有努力、勝過每個大團體或能無限承擔。
brief.misconceptionZh: 小組可有突出影響仍有限制，不把相對強表現當全面第一或容量無限。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體比較支持相對規模的好表現。

listening.en: The two-person archive team punched above its weight: its carefully checked local timeline was used by three larger exhibitions, even though the team could only complete a few enquiries each week.
listening.zh: 兩人檔案團隊表現超出規模預期：仔細核過的本地年表獲三個較大展覽使用，雖然每周只能完成少量查詢。
listening.promptZh: 超出規模的表現及限制是甚麼？

options.en: A small team’s timeline supported larger exhibitions, while enquiry capacity remained limited.
options.zh: 小團隊年表支援較大展覽，查詢容量仍有限。

options.en: The team had more staff than the exhibitions using the timeline.
options.zh: 團隊人手比使用年表的展覽更多。

options.en: The team has accepted every enquiry for this week without an ongoing capacity limit.
options.zh: 團隊已接本周每項查詢，沒有持續容量限制。

options.en: The timeline was prepared by the larger exhibitions instead of the small team.
options.zh: 年表由較大展覽而非小團隊製作。

listening.explanationZh: 兩人年表供大展使用展現影響，但每周仍只少量查詢，未說已全接或容量無限。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼兩人團隊的影響令人印象深？
reply.promptEn: Why was the two-person team’s influence impressive?

options.en: Its checked timeline was useful to three larger exhibitions.
options.zh: 核過的年表對三個較大展覽有用。

options.en: It punched above its weight through a resource others could rely on.
options.zh: 它透過別人可依賴的資源，發揮超出規模的影響。

options.en: The work reached beyond what one might expect from only two people.
options.zh: 工作觸及範圍超出只兩人令人預期的。

options.en: Careful research gave a very small team a wider contribution.
options.zh: 仔細研究讓很小團隊有更廣貢獻。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給規模與影響比較。

scene.promptZh: 五人鄉鎮合唱團作品獲大型聯合演出選用，並未贏所有比賽，也不能每周外演。哪句準確？

options.en: The small choir is punching above its weight through its contribution to the larger performance.
options.zh: 小合唱團透過對大型演出的貢獻，發揮超出規模的影響。

options.en: The choir has already received the first prize for the larger performance.
options.zh: 合唱團已獲大型演出的首獎。

options.en: The choir has already booked a weekly tour instead of a contribution to one larger performance.
options.zh: 合唱團已訂每周巡演，而不是參與一次大型演出。

scene.explanationZh: 已給的是小組作品獲大演出選用，非獎已頒或每周巡演已訂，容量仍有限。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 punch above its weight 得出？

options.en: The impact is strong relative to the group’s scale.
options.zh: 相對小組規模，其影響強。

options.en: It outperforms every larger organisation in every respect.
options.zh: 它每方面都勝過每個更大組織。

options.en: The context should establish both scale and performance.
options.zh: 情境應交代規模及表現。

contrast.explanationZh: 相對規模強，不是全方面全面第一。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說團隊支援三大展，所以應答應所有查詢；但每周只可做少量。哪句最好？

options.en: The wider influence does not expand our hours; we still need a realistic enquiry limit.
options.zh: 影響較廣不會增加時數；仍需實際查詢上限。

options.en: All of this week’s enquiries have already been accepted, so we can promise the next one too.
options.zh: 本周查詢已全部接下，所以也可承諾下一項。

options.en: The larger exhibitions are now handling all our enquiries, leaving the two-person team free.
options.zh: 較大展覽現正處理我們所有查詢，讓兩人團隊空閒。

dialogue.explanationZh: 年表的廣泛影響不改兩人的可用時數；未給已全接查詢或大展已接手的安排，仍需查容量。

speaking.en: The small team punches above its weight, but it still needs clear limits on what it can take on.
speaking.zh: 小團隊發揮超出規模的影響，但仍需清楚承接上限。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把相對影響與容量分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你代表三人校際問答隊寫給校方，團隊與大得多隊伍一起進地區決賽，想用這相對規模的表現爭取固定練習房。你仍承認有科目需練，不把入決賽寫成以後必勝或不需支援。用一至兩句英文提出請求。

examples.en: Our three-person quiz team punched above its weight by reaching the regional final alongside much larger teams. Could the school give us a regular practice room so we can prepare for the next round?
examples.zh: 三人問答隊與大得多團隊一起進地區決賽，發揮超出規模的表現；學校可否給固定練習房，讓我們準備下一輪？

examples.en: We have punched above our weight with only three members, but reaching the final does not remove the need to practise. A regular room would help us work on the subjects we still find difficult.
examples.zh: 只有三名成員，我們仍發揮超出規模的表現，但入決賽不會消除練習需要；固定房間可幫我們練仍覺難的科目。

glossary.en: the subjects we still find difficult

writing.selfCheckZh: 用三人及與大隊同進決賽的比較肯定表現，提出固定練習房的具體支援請求，保留仍需練習，不承諾必勝。

takeaways.en: The small journal punches above its weight by publishing research used well beyond the town.
takeaways.zh: 小刊物發表鎮外廣用的研究，發揮超出規模的影響。

takeaways.en: They punched above their weight without pretending they had the resources of a much larger team.
takeaways.zh: 他們發揮超出規模的影響，沒有假裝擁有大團隊資源。

titleZh: 擴大尋找或接觸的範圍

brief.meaningEn: Search among or reach a broader range of people or possibilities.
brief.meaningZh: 從更廣的人或可能性中尋找，或接觸更廣群體。
brief.grammar: cast a wider net for volunteers/ideas; cast is also past; specify how the search is broadened.
brief.register: Established fishing metaphor. Broadening invitations does not establish who responds or guarantee a representative outcome.
brief.boundaryZh: 擴接觸不等於人人已參與、放寬必要條件或結果必具代表性；需分邀請及實際回應。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可改用不同渠道找人，仍核資格及回覆，不只把同一訊息多寄同一群。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述擴大搜尋的具體方法及未定結果。

sources.sentence: The charity will cast a wider net for volunteers.

listening.en: We cast a wider net for volunteer readers by contacting evening classes as well as the usual library group; we still needed to see who could attend the training.
listening.zh: 我們除平常圖書館小組，也聯絡夜班課程，擴大找義工讀者的範圍；仍需看誰可出席訓練。
listening.promptZh: 搜尋怎樣擴大，甚麼仍未定？

options.en: Another group was contacted, but training attendance was not yet known.
options.zh: 聯絡了另一群體，但訓練出席仍未知。

options.en: The same library list received another identical reminder, with no new group contacted.
options.zh: 同一圖書館名單再收相同提醒，沒聯絡新群體。

options.en: Everyone in the evening classes had already completed the training.
options.zh: 夜班課程每人都已完成訓練。

options.en: The team removed training from the volunteer requirements.
options.zh: 團隊取消義工訓練要求。

listening.explanationZh: 新增夜班課程是擴範圍，仍需看可出席誰，不是全已參加或免訓練。

reply.promptZh: 你們怎樣找更多可能的義工讀者？
reply.promptEn: How did you look for more possible volunteer readers?

options.en: We contacted evening classes in addition to the library group.
options.zh: 除圖書館小組，也聯絡夜班課程。

options.en: We cast a wider net by using another route to potential readers.
options.zh: 我們用另一途徑接觸可能讀者，擴大搜尋範圍。

options.en: The invitation went beyond the group we usually asked.
options.zh: 邀請超出平常問的小組。

options.en: We looked in a new setting rather than only repeat the request to the same people.
options.zh: 我們在新環境找，不只重問同一批人。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給更廣渠道，未代人答應訓練。

scene.promptZh: 設計組原只比較三種海報，現也收錄音導覽及短示範等不同傳達形式，未選最後方案。你想說搜尋已涵蓋更廣可能，不是有人已入選。哪句準確？

options.en: We have cast a wider net for ways to explain the exhibition, including audio and demonstrations.
options.zh: 我們已擴大找解釋展覽方法的範圍，包括聲音及示範。

options.en: We are still considering only the original three poster layouts.
options.zh: 我們仍只考慮原來三種海報版式。

options.en: The audio guide has already been selected as the final format after a completed comparison.
options.zh: 完成比較後，聲音導覽已被選為最後形式。

scene.explanationZh: 搜尋從海報擴到不同傳達形式，並非仍只原三版，也未定最後選擇。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 cast a wider net？

options.en: The search includes channels or groups not previously approached.
options.zh: 搜尋包括先前未接觸的渠道或群體。

options.en: The same small list receives the same invitation again with no broader search.
options.zh: 同一小名單再收同一邀請，沒有擴搜尋。

options.en: A team considers a broader range of possible contributors.
options.zh: 團隊考慮更廣的可能貢獻者。

contrast.explanationZh: 只重寄原群體不必然擴範圍。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說聯絡夜班課程就可把所有人填入訓練名單，但未有回覆。哪句最好？

options.en: We have broadened the invitation, not confirmed attendance; let us wait for replies.
options.zh: 我們擴大邀請，未確認出席；先等回覆。

options.en: The additional contact list is enough to mark those places as filled.
options.zh: 新增聯絡名單已足以把名額標滿。

options.en: No reply yet means the broader search has already proved useless.
options.zh: 未有回覆表示擴大搜尋已證明無用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 邀請、回覆及效果評估各有時序，未回不能算已滿或已無用。

speaking.en: We can cast a wider net without assuming that everyone we contact will take part.
speaking.zh: 我們可擴大接觸範圍，不假定每位接觸者都會參加。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清搜尋與回應。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你查一張舊照片的街名，只問家人仍沒結果，想把照片交地區歷史小組及舊商戶互助網，請人提供線索；仍會核地址紀錄，不能把第一個回覆直接當真。用一至兩句英文告訴家人下一步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用新社群擴大照片辨識線索，保留回覆待核，不以渠道多就保證首答或全答準確。

examples.en: Let us cast a wider net by asking the local history group and the former traders’ network about the street. Any suggested name should still be checked against the address records.
examples.zh: 我們問地區歷史小組及舊商戶網這條街，擴大搜尋；任何建議街名仍需對地址紀錄核。

examples.en: We can cast a wider net for clues instead of asking only the family again. I will share the photograph with the history group and verify any useful suggestions.
examples.zh: 我們可擴大找線索，不只再問家人；我會把相片交歷史小組，核有用建議。

takeaways.en: The organisers cast a wider net for ideas by asking people who had never attended before.
takeaways.zh: 主辦者問從未出席的人，擴大找想法的範圍。

takeaways.en: We are casting a wider net, but we still need to check which proposals meet the brief.
takeaways.zh: 我們正擴大搜尋，但仍需核哪些提案合要求。

titleZh: 繼續發展的空間或機會

brief.meaningEn: Opportunity or capacity for further development.
brief.meaningZh: 進一步發展的機會或容量。
brief.grammar: have/give/leave room to grow; room is uncountable metaphorical space, not necessarily a physical room.
brief.register: Common space metaphor. The development may be in skill, responsibility or an activity; context supplies the dimension.
brief.boundaryZh: 有機會不等於已成長、保證升遷或任何方向都可做；需有可發展的具體部分。
brief.misconceptionZh: 目前合適與往後仍可學習並存，不必把發展空間讀成現在完全不足。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說清可發展的是甚麼及仍待實際學習。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The new role gave her room to grow.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 27, table 2, row 5; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The assistant role gave Arun room to grow because he could begin with preparing materials and later learn to lead a short demonstration with support; he had not yet taken over a full class.
listening.zh: 助理角色給阿倫發展空間，因可先備材料，之後在支援下學帶短示範；他還沒接整班。
listening.promptZh: 發展機會及目前界線是甚麼？

options.en: He could progress from materials to a supported short demonstration, not yet a full class.
options.zh: 他可從備料進到有支援短示範，尚未帶整班。

options.en: He had already become the sole teacher for a full class.
options.zh: 他已成整班唯一老師。

options.en: His duties were permanently restricted to preparing materials with no later learning.
options.zh: 他的職責永久只限備料，沒有後續學習。

options.en: The role concerned moving him into a larger physical classroom.
options.zh: 角色關乎把他調到更大實體課室。

listening.explanationZh: later learn示範是發展，未接整班是現況，不是房間大小。

reply.promptZh: 助理角色怎樣給阿倫發展機會？
reply.promptEn: How did the assistant role offer Arun development?

options.en: He could learn a short demonstration after starting with materials.
options.zh: 先備料後，他可學短示範。

options.en: It gave him room to grow through supported teaching tasks.
options.zh: 角色透過有支援教學任務，給他發展空間。

options.en: The responsibilities could develop gradually beyond preparation alone.
options.zh: 責任可逐步超出單純準備。

options.en: He had a path to learn something new without taking a whole class immediately.
options.zh: 他有路徑學新事，不需立即接整班。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答具體發展路徑，不把機會當已完成。

scene.promptZh: 你加入刊物先校對，之後可跟編輯學訪問設計，但未保證職位升級。哪句準確？

options.en: The role offers room to grow through learning interview design.
options.zh: 角色透過學訪問設計，提供發展空間。

options.en: The opportunity confirms that I have already mastered interviewing.
options.zh: 機會確認我已掌握訪問。

options.en: I have been guaranteed a promotion before beginning the new learning.
options.zh: 未開始新學習前，我已獲升遷保證。

scene.explanationZh: 可學是機會，非掌握或升遷已保證。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 room to grow 得出？

options.en: Further development is possible in the relevant area.
options.zh: 相關範圍可繼續發展。

options.en: The development has already happened without further work.
options.zh: 毋須後續工作，發展已完成。

options.en: The context should explain which opportunity or capacity exists.
options.zh: 情境應說明有哪個機會或容量。

contrast.explanationZh: 空間不是成長本身已發生。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說能之後學示範，就是阿倫現在可獨帶整班；你想保留階段。哪句最好？

options.en: The opportunity is to learn with support; a full class is not his current responsibility.
options.zh: 機會是有支援地學；整班不是目前責任。

options.en: The learning path means he should now be listed as the sole teacher.
options.zh: 有學習路徑，表示現在應列他為唯一老師。

options.en: If he is not ready for a full class, there is no development opportunity in the assistant role.
options.zh: 若未可接整班，助理角色就沒發展機會。

dialogue.explanationZh: 現階段及發展機會可並存，不由可學推已具能力，也不因未到終點否定空間。

speaking.en: The role gives me room to grow, but I still need practice before taking on the next responsibility.
speaking.zh: 角色給我發展空間，但接下項責任前仍需練習。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清機會與實際成長。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們想辦一份小刊，有人想創刊就放新聞、評論及訪問各十篇，現只有足夠稿做一個本地主題。你想提議先做清楚短版，為日後作者準備好時加欄目留空間，三期後再檢視，不保證擴版。用一至兩句英文提案。

examples.en: Let us begin with one clear local theme and leave room to grow when more contributors are ready. We can review possible new sections after three issues.
examples.zh: 先以一個清楚本地主題開始，待更多作者準備好時留發展空間；三期後可檢視新欄目。

examples.en: A short first issue can still have room to grow, rather than promise ten pieces in every section now. I suggest a review after three issues before we agree on any expansion.
examples.zh: 短創刊仍可有發展空間，不現在承諾每欄十篇；我建議三期後檢視，再議任何擴展。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把發展空間用於刊物欄目及未來稿源，提議短版及三期檢視，不保證擴版。

takeaways.en: The small project left room to grow as volunteers learned new roles.
takeaways.zh: 義工學新角色時，小項目保留發展空間。

takeaways.en: She wanted a role with room to grow, not a promise that she would already know everything.
takeaways.zh: 她想要有發展空間的角色，不是說自己已知所有事的保證。

brief.meaningEn: Greater financial resources than another person or organisation.
brief.meaningZh: 相較另一人或組織，擁有更多財務資源。
brief.grammar: have deeper pockets than...; competitors with deeper pockets; comparative form needs an explicit or understood comparison.
brief.register: Established pocket metaphor. Resources do not establish quality, intentions or unlimited spending.
brief.boundaryZh: 財力較多不等於沒上限、品質較佳、必取勝或已決定出資；需分清能力及實際承諾。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可支應較大費用仍可有預算限制，不從資源比較推出所有結果。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用比較描述資源差異，保留決策及成效未定。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Large competitors often have deeper pockets.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 27, table 2, row 6; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Large competitors often have deeper pockets.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 64, table 1, row 2; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The larger publisher had deeper pockets than our small journal and could pay for a longer print run, but we did not yet know which version readers would find more useful.
listening.zh: 大出版社比我們小刊物財力厚，可付較長印量，但未知讀者會覺哪版更有用。
listening.promptZh: 財力比較確立甚麼，沒有確立甚麼？

options.en: The publisher could fund more copies, not that readers would prefer its version.
options.zh: 出版社可付更多本，不是讀者會較喜歡它版本。

options.en: The larger print run had already proved the publisher’s version more useful to readers.
options.zh: 較大印量已證出版社版本較有用。

options.en: The small journal had the larger budget and was paying the publisher.
options.zh: 小刊物有更大預算，正付款給出版社。

options.en: The publisher has already funded an additional print run beyond the one described.
options.zh: 出版社已資助所述之外的額外印量。

listening.explanationZh: 已知財力可付較長印量，未給另一額外印刷已獲資助，也未確立讀者覺哪版較有用。

reply.promptZh: 大出版社相比小刊物有甚麼資源優勢？
reply.promptEn: What resource advantage did the larger publisher have?

options.en: It could afford a longer print run.
options.zh: 它付得起較大印量。

options.en: It had deeper pockets than our journal.
options.zh: 它比我們刊物財力厚。

options.en: More financial resources were available for producing copies.
options.zh: 有較多財務資源可印本。

options.en: Its budget could support a printing commitment beyond ours.
options.zh: 其預算可支援超出我們能力的印刷承諾。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答財務容量比較，不推品質勝負。

scene.promptZh: 大型機構可付專人維護網站，小社團只可輪流義務維護；還未比內容品質。哪句準確？

options.en: The institution has deeper pockets, allowing it to pay for dedicated maintenance.
options.zh: 機構財力較厚，讓它可付專人維護。

options.en: A completed content comparison has found the institution’s information more accurate.
options.zh: 已完成內容比較顯示機構資料較準確。

options.en: The club has already hired more paid staff than the institution.
options.zh: 社團已聘比機構更多有薪人員。

scene.explanationZh: 已給付專人維護的能力，未比較內容準確，不是內容評估已完成或社團聘人更多。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 deeper pockets 單獨得出？

options.en: One side has greater financial resources in the comparison.
options.zh: 比較中一方財務資源更多。

options.en: That side is guaranteed to produce the better result.
options.zh: 該方保證會有較好成果。

options.en: Context can show what the extra resources make possible.
options.zh: 情境可顯示額外資源讓甚麼成為可能。

contrast.explanationZh: 財力不是成果保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說出版社印更多本，就可在評語寫它版本一定較有用；讀者未比較。哪句最好？

options.en: The budget explains the print run; usefulness still needs evidence from the versions and readers.
options.zh: 預算解釋印量；有用程度仍需版本及讀者的證據。

options.en: The number of funded copies is enough to rank the two versions for usefulness.
options.zh: 獲資助印本數量已足以排兩版有用程度。

options.en: The smaller journal has already matched the publisher’s longer print run.
options.zh: 小刊物已做到與出版社較長印量相同。

dialogue.explanationZh: 出版社財力支持較長印量，小刊物未說已追平；有用程度仍需另看版本與讀者，不只數印本。

speaking.en: They have deeper pockets, but that does not tell us which proposal will work better for the users.
speaking.zh: 他們財力較厚，但這不告訴我們哪提案對使用者更有效。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清財力與成果。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替虛構藝術社準備申請資助，某基金會比小社財力厚，但未答應任何款。你要寫給組員，說下一步先問申請程序及所需資料，不把對方能出錢當已承諾，未獲批前也不預支其款。用一至兩句英文安排。

examples.en: The foundation has deeper pockets than our club, but it has not promised funding. I will ask about the application process and required evidence before we count on its support.
examples.zh: 基金會比我們社財力厚，但未承諾資助；依賴其支持前，我會問申請程序及所需證據。

examples.en: They have deeper pockets, which makes them a possible sponsor rather than a confirmed one. Let us find out how to apply before including their money in the project plan.
examples.zh: 他們財力較厚，是可能而非已確認贊助者；把其款放進項目計劃前，先問怎申請。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用財力比較辨可能資助者並安排查程序，保留未有款項承諾。

takeaways.en: The bigger organisation had deeper pockets, but it still needed to decide which requests to fund.
takeaways.zh: 更大組織財力較厚，但仍需決定資助哪些請求。

takeaways.en: Competitors with deeper pockets could afford more advertising, without knowing how every customer would respond.
takeaways.zh: 財力較厚的競爭者可付更多廣告費，卻不知道每位顧客怎回應。
